description: Full ESCO records for the occupations in the Occupation lens: preferred labels in EU/EEA languages, English description, ISCO-08 unit group and essential skills.
source: ESCO — European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations, European Commission
acknowledgement: This service uses the ESCO classification of the European Commission.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/05.label: bricklayer
http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/05.description: Bricklayers assemble brick walls and structures by skilfully laying the bricks in an established pattern, using a binding agent like cement to bond the bricks together. They then fill the joints with mortar or other suitable materials.

essential_skills.title: follow health and safety procedures in construction
follow safety procedures when working at heights

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/09.label: hairdresser
http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/09.description: Hairdressers offer beauty services such as cutting, colouring, bleaching, permanent waving and styling clients' hair. They ask their clients about their hairstyle preferences in order to provide customised services. Hairdressers use clippers, scissors and razors. They provide hair and scalp treatments and shampoo, condition and rinse hair.

essential_skills.title: stay up-to-date with hair style trends

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/15.label: construction painter
http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/15.description: Construction painters paint the interior and exterior of buildings and other structures. They may use standard latex based paints or specialised paints for decorative effect or protective properties. Building painters are skilled in using brushes, paint rollers and paint sprayers for different applications.

essential_skills.title: follow health and safety procedures in construction
follow safety procedures when working at heights

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/1a.label: baker
http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/1a.description: Bakers make a wide range of breads, pastries, and other baked goods. They follow all the processes from receipt and storage of raw materials, preparation of raw materials for bread-making, measurement and mixing of ingredients into dough and proof. They tend ovens to bake products to an adequate temperature and time.

essential_skills.title: check quality of products on the production line
follow hygienic procedures during food processing
administer lactic ferment cultures to manufacturing products
apply requirements concerning manufacturing of food and beverages
ensure correct use of bakery equipment

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/2a.label: carpenter
http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/2a.description: Carpenters cut, shape and assemble wooden elements for the construction of buildings and other structures. They also use materials such as plastic and metal in their creations. Carpenters create the wooden frames to support wood framed buildings.

essential_skills.title: keep sawing equipment in good condition
follow health and safety procedures in construction

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/34.label: child care worker

labels.cs: pracovník péče o děti/pracovnice péče o děti
labels.fr: éducateur en petite enfance/éducatrice en petite enfance
labels.it: addetto alla sorveglianza di bambini/addetta alla sorveglianza di bambini

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/34.description: Child care workers provide care for children when the parents or family members are unavailable. They look after the children's basic needs and help or supervise them during play. Child care workers can work for preschools, daycare centres, childcare agencies or individual families.

essential_skills.title: assist children in developing personal skills
attend to children's basic physical needs

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/37.label: butcher
http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/37.description: Butchers order, inspect and buy meat to prepare it and sell it as consumable meat products. They perform activities such as cutting, trimming, boning, tying, and grinding beef, pork, and poultry meat. They prepare those mentioned sorts of meat for consumption.

isco_group.title: Butchers, fishmongers and related food preparers

essential_skills.title: work in a food processing team
follow an environmental friendly policy while processing food
consider economic criteria in decision making
handle knives for meat processing activities
ensure refrigeration of food in the supply chain
cultural practices regarding animal parts sorting
apply requirements concerning manufacturing of food and beverages
monitor temperature in manufacturing process of food and beverages
follow hygienic procedures during food processing

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/49.label: electrician

labels.de: Industrieelektriker – Geräte und Systeme/Industrieelektrikerin – Geräte und Systeme

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/49.description: Electricians fit and repair electrical circuits and wiring systems. They also install and maintain electrical equipment and machinery. This work can be performed indoors as well as outdoors, in nearly every type of facility.

essential_skills.title: react to events in time-critical environments
follow health and safety procedures in construction

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/4a.label: vehicle technician

labels.pt: Técnico de veículos a motor/Técnica de veículos a motor

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/4a.description: Vehicle technicians inspect, test and maintain vehicles, motorcycles, engine tune-ups and tyre replacements. They repair engine failures, lube replacements. Vehicle technicians replace vehicle components and evaluate warranty options.

essential_skills.title: follow procedures to control substances hazardous to health
mechanical requirements for vehicles in urban areas
health and safety measures in transportation
position vehicles for maintenance and repair
provide customer information related to repairs
carry out repairs and maintenance of vehicle bodies
perform technical tasks with great care
adapt to new technology used in cars

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/7a.label: welder
http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/7a.description: Welders operate welding equipment in order to join metal workpieces together. They can use fusion welding processes based on different techniques and materials. They also perform simple visual inspection of welds.

essential_skills.title: follow health and safety procedures in construction
follow safety precautions in work practices

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/90.label: cook
http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/90.description: Cooks are culinary operatives who are able to prepare and present food, normally in domestic and institutional environments.

essential_skills.title: maintain a safe, hygienic and secure working environment
ensure cleanliness of food preparation area
maintain kitchen equipment at correct temperature
comply with food safety and hygiene

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/9b.label: sales assistant
http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/9b.description: Sales assistants represent the direct contact with clients. They provide general advice to customers.

essential_skills.title: provide customer guidance on product selection

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/d3.label: healthcare assistant

labels.es: técnico de atención sociosanitaria/técnica de atención sociosanitaria
labels.hr: djelatnik/djelatnica za zdravstvenu i socijalnu skrb u ustanovama
labels.sv: undersköterska, vård- och specialavdelning och mottagning

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/d3.description: Healthcare assistants work in teams of nurses within the occupational fields of nursing, social care, clinical care and care of people of all age-groups. Healthcare assistants assist in the promotion and restoration of patients' health by providing physical and psychological support to patients, friends and families.

essential_skills.title: comply with quality standards related to healthcare practice
advise on healthcare users' informed consent
comply with legislation related to health care
contribute to continuity of health care
inform policy makers on health-related challenges
work in a multicultural environment in health care
respond to changing situations in health care
educate on the prevention of illness
use e-health and mobile health technologies

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/d5.label: waiter/waitress
http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/d5.description: Waiters/waitresses supply guests with food and drinks as requested. Waiters/waitresses usually work in restaurants, bars and hotels. This involves the preparation of tables, serving food or beverages and taking payments.

essential_skills.title: comply with food safety and hygiene
advise guests on menus for special events
food and beverages on the menu
attend to detail regarding food and beverages
take food and beverage orders from customers

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/e1.label: cabinet maker
http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/e1.description: Cabinet makers build cabinets or other pieces of furniture by cutting, shaping and fitting pieces of wood. They use different kind of power and hand tools, such as lathes, planers and saws.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/e7.label: landscape gardener
http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/e7.description: Landscape gardeners plan, construct, renovate and maintain parks, gardens and public green spaces.

essential_skills.title: transport physical resources within the work area
handling chemical products for soil and plants
environmental legislation in agriculture and forestry
execute disease and pest control activities

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/ed.label: plumber

labels.hr: vodoinstalater i plinoinstalater / vodoinstalaterka i plinoinstalaterka

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/ed.description: Plumbers maintain and install water, gas and sewage systems. They inspect pipes and fixtures on a regular basis or make repairs as needed. They bend, cut, and install pipes. They test systems and make adjustments safely and following regulations. They place sanitary equipment.

essential_skills.title: follow health and safety procedures in construction

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/ed.label: mechatronics engineering technician

labels.es: ingeniero técnico de mecatrónica/ingeniera técnica de mecatrónica
labels.pt: Técnico de engenharia mecatrónica/Técnica de engenharia mecatrónica

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/ed.description: Mechatronics engineering technicians collaborate with engineers in the development of mechatronic devices and applications through a combination of mechanical engineering, electronic engineering, and computer engineering. They build, test, install, and calibrate mechatronics and solve technical problems.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/f2.label: software developer

labels.hr: razvojni programer softvera / razvojna programerka softvera

http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/f2.description: Software developers implement or program all kinds of software systems based on specifications and designs by using programming languages, tools, and platforms.
